svg.aria-label: A pick-and-place gantry on a bench. On the left, five spec cards from Fig 2 lie in a tray, beside a stack of blank task tiles. A picker on a cantilever arm takes one tile at a time, touches it to the spec it comes from, and sets it in the backlog of one of three sprint trays, in dependency order. Each tray has four state compartments. As each tile lands, a row is written on the PLAN.md ledger. At the end every compartment gets a .gitkeep peg and every spec shows a coverage flag.
